game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: hikingben2026
quote:
Ignore the fake review saying this game is awful, review-bombed by people calling it "woke and mid".

The game is an absolute masterpiece, graphically beautiful and the story is fantastic. Play the game yourself, and ignore reviews from people who've never played the game. Form your own opinion, rather than following the "anti-woke" sheep.
